```{r}
rm(list=ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(plyr)
library(lubridate)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstan)
library(bridgesampling)

source("Fit/Functions_fit.R")
```

# Data

```{r}
load("Data/Canada/data_canada_province.RData") # import data
```

```{r}
data_ca$IAV_scaled_cases <- data_ca$IAV_scaled_cases_lag3
data_at$IAV_scaled_cases <- data_at$IAV_scaled_cases_lag3
data_bc$IAV_scaled_cases <- data_bc$IAV_scaled_cases_lag3
data_on$IAV_scaled_cases <- data_on$IAV_scaled_cases_lag3
data_pr$IAV_scaled_cases <- data_pr$IAV_scaled_cases_lag3

data_ca$IAV_scaled_cases_smooth <- smooth_cases(data_ca)
data_at$IAV_scaled_cases_smooth <- smooth_cases(data_at)
data_bc$IAV_scaled_cases_smooth <- smooth_cases(data_bc)
data_on$IAV_scaled_cases_smooth <- smooth_cases(data_on)
data_pr$IAV_scaled_cases_smooth <- smooth_cases(data_pr)

plot_grid(
  
  ggplot(data_ca, aes(x=date)) +
    geom_point(aes(y=IAV_scaled_cases), pch=1) +
    geom_line(aes(y=IAV_scaled_cases_smooth)),
  
  ggplot(data_at, aes(x=date)) +
    geom_point(aes(y=IAV_scaled_cases), pch=1) +
    geom_line(aes(y=IAV_scaled_cases_smooth)),
  
  ggplot(data_bc, aes(x=date)) +
    geom_point(aes(y=IAV_scaled_cases), pch=1) +
    geom_line(aes(y=IAV_scaled_cases_smooth)),
  
  ggplot(data_on, aes(x=date)) +
    geom_point(aes(y=IAV_scaled_cases), pch=1) +
    geom_line(aes(y=IAV_scaled_cases_smooth)),
  
  ggplot(data_pr, aes(x=date)) +
    geom_point(aes(y=IAV_scaled_cases), pch=1) +
    geom_line(aes(y=IAV_scaled_cases_smooth)),
  
  ncol=2)
```

```{r}
n_chains <- 4 # = number of cores as well
n_warmup <- 2000
n_iter <- n_warmup + 2000

gamma <- 2 # approx 8 days for recovery
mu <- 1/80/52 # natural mortality

pop <- read.csv("Data/Canada/Canada_pop_size.csv")
```

```{r}
data_ca_stan <- data_stan(data=data_ca, mu=mu, gamma=gamma, pop=pop$pop_2021[pop$Province=="Canada"])
data_at_stan <- data_stan(data=data_at, mu=mu, gamma=gamma, pop=pop$pop_2021[pop$Province=="Atlantic"])
data_bc_stan <- data_stan(data=data_bc, mu=mu, gamma=gamma, pop=pop$pop_2021[pop$Province=="British Columbia"])
data_on_stan <- data_stan(data=data_on, mu=mu, gamma=gamma, pop=pop$pop_2021[pop$Province=="Ontario"])
data_pr_stan <- data_stan(data=data_pr, mu=mu, gamma=gamma, pop=pop$pop_2021[pop$Province=="Prairies"])
```

# With viral interaction

```{r}
model <- stan_model("Fit/Stan_models/SIRS_npi_vi.stan")
parms <- c("logbeta0", "eps_beta[1]", "eps_beta[2]", "eps_beta[3]", "eps_beta[4]", "sigma_beta",
           "kappa", "phi", "omega", "rho", "S0", "I0", "sigma")
```

------- National (Canada) ------------------------------------------------------
  
```{r, eval=FALSE}
fit <- sampling(model, data=data_ca_stan,
                chains=n_chains, iter=n_iter, warmup=n_warmup, seed=1001,
                control=list(adapt_delta=0.95, max_treedepth=15),
                cores=n_chains)

saveRDS(fit, "Fit/Output/fit_RV_SIRS_npi_vi_ca_lag3.RDS")
saveRDS(bridge_sampler(fit), file="Fit/Output/bridge_RV_SIRS_npi_vi_ca_lag3.RDS")
```

```{r}
fit <- readRDS("Fit/Output/fit_RV_SIRS_npi_vi_ca_lag3.RDS")

check_hmc_diagnostics(fit)
get_num_divergent(fit)
get_num_max_treedepth(fit)
get_low_bfmi_chains(fit)
get_bfmi(fit)

summary(fit)$summary[c(1:4,53:60),]
```

```{r}
posterior <- extract(fit)

traceplot(fit, pars=parms)
pairs(fit, pars=parms)
plot_fit(posterior, data_ca)
plot_beta(posterior)
```
